joule.note: Air approval orders found for Joule sites with 69 gas engines of 3,392 hp each, about 175 MW per site (my conversion: 69 x 3,392 hp x 0.7457 kW/hp). I found orders for one to two sites; how many are final is not confirmed.

properties.name: Stratos / Wonder Valley
properties.who_decides: Military Installation Development Authority for land use; State Engineer for water; state agencies for air and water quality

notes.land: MIDA approved the project and the county consented to the project area. The governor said this decision covers land use only. A county moratorium does not apply because MIDA holds jurisdiction.
notes.water: Two earlier change applications (a54385 for 1,900 af; a54536 for 11 af) were withdrawn in May after thousands of protests. Protests do not carry over. A new application, a55167, was filed October 15; its protest window closed November 4. A hearing is the next step.
notes.air: No application found. The state environmental quality commissioner said in May that air and water permitting were at least a year away.

properties.gaps: Air and water-quality filings; hearing date for a55167; number of protests on a55167 (an advocacy newsletter reported 287 early on).

sources.label: Salt Lake Tribune: second application withdrawn
FOX 13: executive order and DEQ timing
Herald Journal: MIDA decision is land use only

phases.note: First phase. The governor said it would not exceed 1.5 GW; the health report describes a 3 GW first phase. No date published, so the project's start year is used.

capacity.fullNote: 9 GW full buildout; no date published.

properties.name: Joule campus
properties.who_decides: Millard County for land use; Utah Division of Air Quality for air

notes.land: County rezoned about 4,000 acres to heavy industrial in August 2025 and said a conditional use permit was also required. I did not confirm the permit's issuance, but the project is reported under construction.
notes.water: No water-right filing found. Your notes list about 10,000 af of rights.
notes.air: Approval orders issued, including DAQE-AN162810001-26 (69 gas engines, 69 diesel emergency generators, 69 chillers) and DAQE-AN162920001-26 (Site 4, a new major source). A draft permit for Power Station 4 (up to 175 MW) was proposed August 5 with comments to September 4. The campus plans six such plants.

properties.gaps: Final decision on the Site 4 draft; permits for the other plants; water rights; conditional use permit document.

sources.label: Oil & Gas Watch: draft permit alert

phases.note: 1 GW initial phase from gas generators; a tracker reports first power targeted for late 2026.

capacity.fullNote: 4,000+ MW per your notes; some reports cite up to 12 GW.

properties.name: Creekstone Delta Gigasite
properties.who_decides: Millard County for land use; Utah Division of Air Quality for air

notes.land: About 1,143 acres zoned heavy industrial, with a conditional use permit covering the data center and on-site power generation.
notes.water: No filing found. The developer claims a technology that would generate water; your notes say large-scale water generation is likely years away.
notes.air: No air permit found. The first power block is reported as 29 gas engines of about 230 MW, with power planned for 2027.

sources.label: CompressorTech: gas capacity and permit status

phases.note: About 220 MW first generating block; on-site power planned for 2027.

capacity.fullNote: More than 10 GW of generating capacity envisioned. A tracker lists 4.61 GW of full-build data center (IT) load, so generation and server load differ.

properties.name: Antelope (Pronghorn)
properties.who_decides: Iron County planning commission; hearing officer on appeal; Utah Division of Air Quality

notes.land: Conditional use permit approved June 4 for about a 250-acre footprint of 640 acres. Residents appealed to a hearing officer. I could not confirm the outcome. The county planner said the permit is not a permit to build.
notes.water: No water-right filing found. The application hopes to use Cedar Valley Water Conservancy supply, else acquire rights. The area is a managed groundwater basin.
notes.air: Required as a condition. No air application found.

properties.gaps: Appeal outcome; air permit application; water source.

phases.note: Full 1.5 GW gas plant targeted for 2033.

properties.name: Red Butte (BrightNight)
properties.tier_label: Proposed, on hold or in negotiation

notes.land: Application submitted May 4, deemed incomplete May 22, and put on hold under the moratorium. The moratorium was repealed October 26, so the developer can refile under the new overlay rules.
notes.water: The application estimates about 1,900 af/yr (this is an estimate, not a water-right filing). The site is in a groundwater management area. Your notes said no figure was published, so this updates them.

properties.gaps: Whether a new application has been filed since October 26.

sources.label: Salt Lake Tribune: open house and water area

capacity.fullNote: 1.5 GW data center and gas plant per your notes; on hold, no dates.

properties.name: Nine Mile (Energence)
properties.who_decides: Duchesne County; EPA and state agencies for the power plant; Tri-County Health Department

notes.land: Complete application March 11 (960 acres). Planning commission approved conditional use permits April 2 for the data center, a gas plant (Wells Draw Energy), solar, and a reWater expansion. County commission denied appeals April 27, one for lack of standing.
notes.water: County materials say the final operating volume, water-right chain and priority dates are not established.
notes.air: County staff said EPA permitting and emission controls are prerequisites to operating the gas plant. No application found.
notes.wq: On-site septic planned through the health department. No filing found.
notes.build: Construction not begun as of May.

properties.gaps: Air application; water rights; any further appeal.

phases.note: About 400 MW gas plant; operation planned by 2029. A tracker also lists 333 MW of solar, not counted here.

properties.name: CyrusOne at Dugway
properties.tier_label: Proposed, on hold or in negotiation
properties.who_decides: U.S. Army (Enhanced Use Lease); Army Corps of Engineers for environmental review

notes.land: The Army conditionally selected CyrusOne on March 26 to enter exclusive negotiations for about 1,201 acres. No final lease signed in the sources I found. An environmental review by the Army Corps of Engineers comes before work begins. First operating capability is projected for fiscal 2029.
notes.water: No filing found. The Army says developers will build their own power and water solutions.

properties.gaps: Lease status; environmental review documents; state permits.

capacity.fullNote: 1,000 MW proposed per your notes. The Army projects first operating capability in fiscal 2029 but has not published its size.

properties.name: Tooele Valley Public Infrastructure District (about 500 MW)
properties.tier_label: Proposed, on hold or in negotiation
properties.who_decides: Utah Inland Port Authority financing; Division of Water Quality for the discharge permit

notes.land: Land-use approvals not found. The district is financed with over $240 million from the port authority, per an advocacy group.

notes.wq: A draft discharge permit (UT0026409) would allow up to 260,000 gallons a day of reverse-osmosis brine into a channel flowing to wetlands near Great Salt Lake. A public hearing was held July 27. I did not find a decision.

properties.name: Nebo North (Mona)
properties.who_decides: Juab County; Williams gas line; state agencies

notes.land: Planning commission approved the conditional use permit April 15 after a four-minute hearing. Neighbors filed an appeal in mid-September. County commissioners said they were unsure they could reverse it.
notes.air: No filing found. A gas pipeline was reportedly planned for on-site power.

properties.gaps: Appeal outcome; water and air filings.

notes.land: Conditional use permits approved November 2024 and, for a reconfigured site, November 2025.
notes.water: A tracker reports about 300 af/yr consumptive use from leased well water. No water-right filing found.
notes.air: Island power with natural gas noted in minutes. No filing found.

properties.name: Project Juniper
properties.tier_label: Proposed, on hold or in negotiation
properties.who_decides: Iron County and Utah Inland Port Authority

notes.land: A proposed industrial campus of over 830 acres that could include data centers. The port authority was scheduled November 5 to consider adding the land to a project area. I did not find the outcome. A formal county application could not be filed during the moratorium.

properties.gaps: Outcome of the November 5 consideration; any application since October 26.

properties.tier_label: Proposed, on hold or in negotiation

notes.land: The town had received no development application as of September 25. A 933-acre business park that could include data centers.
notes.water: No filing found. Developers told commissioners they want closed-loop, air-cooled systems.
